data.name: Noctheron: The Eclipse Bringer
data.detailed_description:
Noctheron: The Eclipse Bringer is a dark pixel art RPG focused on story, exploration, and turn-based battles. Set against a war driven by the ambition of three kingdoms, it follows a tale of power, loss, romance, and moral choices, where every decision helps shape the protagonist’s path and the fate of those around him.

In an age consumed by moral decay, each chapter reveals new conflicts, enemies, and regions torn apart by violence, superstition, and despair. Use fear, theatricality, and the power of a mysterious sword to face cruel figures and leave your mark on a world that no longer believes in salvation.

Between the Man and the Legend

The journey explores the duality between Auren Draguësthi and Noctheron: the man behind the mask and the legend born from fear. Between the humanity he still holds onto and the creature the world believes it sees, your actions will define whether Noctheron is remembered as justice, a curse, or something even worse.

Explore decaying regions, face cruel figures, take part in conflicts between kingdoms, and choose how your character evolves. Develop offensive and defensive abilities, use gadgets, and adapt your playstyle to face each threat in your own way.

The Duality Between Auren Draguësthi and Noctheron

Behind the mask is Auren Draguësthi, a man divided between the last traces of his humanity and the dark legend being born around him.

Explore a Decaying World in Pixel Art

Travel through villages, roads, and shadowed environments as you uncover secrets, threats, and fragments of a land consumed by plague, fear, and corruption.

Side-View Turn-Based Battles with Strategic Depth

Face enemies in side-view turn-based battles, where every decision can shift the course of the fight. Choose between offensive abilities, defensive techniques, and gadgets to adapt your strategy against different threats.

Survival is about more than attacking. It requires reading the enemy, preparing your next move, and controlling the pace of battle.

Moral Choices That Shape the Journey and the World’s Perception

In Noctheron, every dialogue, confrontation, and moral decision helps shape how the world sees him. Your choices can inspire fear, respect, hatred, or unexpected consequences, influencing relationships, conflicts, and the path that leads to the birth of Noctheron.

Romance, Alliances, and Relationships Marked by Tension, Loss, and Consequence

Amid war, fear, and corruption, Auren Draguësthi still holds bonds that remind him of his humanity. Romance, alliances, and personal choices will carry weight throughout the journey, shaping relationships marked by tension, desire, guilt, and consequence.

But the more Noctheron is born in the shadows, the harder it becomes to protect what Auren still fears losing.

Forge Terror Your Own Way

Noctheron’s sword is not just a weapon. It is part of his transformation. Throughout the journey, develop abilities, master gadgets, and choose how to face each enemy: through aggression, endurance, control, or precision.

Every tool shapes the way Noctheron imposes fear, turns battles into sentences, and draws closer to the legend the world will learn to fear.

Command Armies in a War Between Three Kingdoms

Make strategic decisions as Auren Draguësthi, lead armies, and influence the fate of a continent divided by ambition, fear, and corruption. Each conflict reveals new alliances, enemies, and consequences that shape the rise of Noctheron.

data.short_description: In a medieval world consumed by plague, fear, and corruption, a masked creature emerges to turn the vilest men into omens of horror. Become Noctheron, the Eclipse Bringer, and make those who thrive in darkness fear what they once claimed to command.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL-compatible GPU / DirectX 10 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated GPU or entry-level dedicated GPU compatible with WebGL
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device

content_descriptors.notes: Noctheron: The Eclipse Bringer contains mature dark fantasy themes, including a grim medieval world affected by plague, fear, corruption and moral decay. The game features stylized pixel art violence, psychological horror elements, and confrontations with cruel and violent figures. There is no nudity, sexual content, or explicit sexual material.
